additionalTopics.summary: 根据卑诗省《信息自由与隐私保护法》（BC FIPPA），教师及助教不得强制要求学生使用涉及共享个人信息的生成式 AI 或其他技术工具，除非该工具已通过 UBC 隐私影响评估（PIA）并获准用于该用途。师生不得将个人信息输入任何未经 UBC FIPPA 合规评估的生成式 AI 工具中，否则可能构成隐私侵权。在教学场景中，学生及学习数据（包括可识别的成绩与考试材料）原则上不得（should not）输入任何未就该特定目的完成 PIA 评估的 AI 工具用于评估反馈或判分。全校统一的集中式 AI 采购登记库在已审核公开记录中仍未核实。

do.en: Get express permission from your instructor, supervisor, or program before using GenAI in assessed work, and check the course syllabus statement (Senate V-130 / O-130.1).
do.zh: 在评分考核作品中使用生成式 AI 前必须获得授课教师、导师或项目明确许可，并查阅课程大纲中的 GenAI 说明条款（参议院 V-130 / O-130.1）。

do.en: Follow course acknowledgement rules when AI is permitted, and in UBC Vancouver Graduate School theses declare each AI tool and purpose in the Preface (or state non-use).
do.zh: 在获准使用 AI 的课程中遵守标注规范；在 UBC 温哥华校区研究生院学位论文前言中列明每种工具与用途（或明确声明未使用）。

do.en: Check purpose-specific UBC privacy approval; in instructor-required course use of Copilot for Organizations, required student inputs are limited to U1 Low Risk information.
do.zh: 核实符合具体用途的 UBC 隐私审批；教师强制课程使用 Copilot for Organizations 时，可要求学生输入的内容限于 U1 低风险信息。

dont.en: Do not enter personal, confidential, or student grading data into uncleared AI tools, and do not require students to sign up for ChatGPT 5 with an account in a course.
dont.zh: 切勿将个人信息、机密资料或学生成绩输入未经 PIA 审批的 AI 工具，且不得在课程中强制要求学生注册使用 ChatGPT 5 有账号版本。

dont.en: Do not treat institutional access to Copilot Chat (Basic) or CTLT low-risk PIA status for ChatGPT 5 (Without An Account) as permission to use AI on assessed work.
dont.zh: 切勿将机构的 Copilot Chat（Basic）访问权限或 CTLT 对 ChatGPT 5（无账号版）的低风险 PIA 状态视作可在考核作业中使用 AI 的许可。

dont.en: Do not use generative AI in examinations or assignments without express permission; unauthorized use is subject to Academic Calendar misconduct and §11 appeal rules.
dont.zh: 未经明确许可切勿在考试或作业中使用生成式 AI；违规使用将按《大学历书》学术不端规章及第 11 节申诉程序处理。

coursework.en: Students may only use generative AI for coursework and assignments if expressly permitted by their instructor or program. Effective September 1, 2026, Vancouver Senate Policy V-130 and Okanagan Senate Policy O-130.1 require syllabi for all credit-bearing courses (graduate-level theses and dissertation courses are exempt) to include a GenAI usage statement, provided within the first week of class unless the syllabus is created in consultation with the student(s) at the beginning of a course section (in which case it must be finalized prior to the last date to drop the course without receiving a "W" on the transcript).
coursework.zh: 学生仅在授课教师或所属学术项目明确许可的情况下，方可在课程作业与平时评估中使用生成式 AI。自 2026 年 9 月 1 日起，温哥华校区参议院政策 V-130 与奥肯那根校区参议院政策 O-130.1 要求所有学分课程（研究生学位论文与毕业论文课程豁免）的教学大纲必须包含生成式 AI 使用说明条款，须在开学第一周内向学生提供，除非该大纲是在开课之初与学生协商制定的（在此情况下，须在不记录成绩单 W 的退课截止日期前最终确定）。

exams.en: Students must not use generative AI in examinations or other assessed work unless expressly permitted by their course instructor or program. University-wide uniform exam exemption rules were not identified in the specific reviewed UBC sources; assessment-level boundaries are set by instructors and unauthorized use is addressed as academic misconduct under the Vancouver and Okanagan Academic Calendars.
exams.zh: 除非授课教师或所属学术项目明确许可，学生严禁在考试或其他正式考核中使用生成式 AI。在已审核的具体 UBC 证据中，未发现全校统一的考试豁免规则；具体的考核使用界限由教师设定，未经授权的使用行为将依据温哥华与奥肯那根《大学历书》按学术不端予以处理。

disclosure.en: Where GenAI is permitted in assessed coursework, educators specify when and how students must acknowledge its use. In the Faculty of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies (Graduate School) at UBC Vancouver (grad.ubc.ca), graduate students must obtain supervisor/committee approval for substantive GenAI use and must declare in the thesis or dissertation Preface each AI tool used and its purpose, or include a clear statement that generative AI was not deliberately used for any aspect of the work (UBCO College of Graduate Studies thesis preface specifications were not separately verified in reviewed sources).
disclosure.zh: 在获准使用生成式 AI 的平时作业中，教师须明确学生应在何时以及如何标注 AI 的使用。在 UBC 温哥华校区研究生与博士后学院（Graduate School，grad.ubc.ca），研究生对生成式 AI 的实质性使用须事先获得导师或指导委员会的批准，且必须在学位论文或毕业论文的“前言”（Preface）中逐一列明使用的 AI 工具名称及其具体用途，或者明确声明未在论文的任何环节蓄意使用生成式 AI（已审核来源中未单独验证 UBCO 研究生院的论文前言细则）。

privacy_data.en: Do not enter personal information into unapproved AI tools; student learning/grading data requires a PIA approved for that purpose. CTLT guidance concerns instructor-required course tool use, not voluntary student choice: it says instructors cannot require ChatGPT 5 with an account, and limits what students can be instructed to share with Copilot for Organizations to Standard U1 Low Risk information. Other Copilot use follows current authorized-purpose, privacy, security and records requirements.
privacy_data.zh: 切勿将个人信息输入未经批准的 AI 工具；若将学生学习或评分数据输入 AI 工具，必须通过专门为此用途批准的隐私影响评估（PIA）。CTLT 指南主要针对教师强制要求的课程工具使用，而非学生自愿的个人选择：该指南明确教师不得要求学生注册使用 ChatGPT 5 账号版，并限制向学生布置使用企业版 Copilot（Copilot for Organizations）时仅可输入标准 U1 低风险信息。其他 Copilot 的使用必须遵循当前的授权用途、隐私、信息安全及记录管理规定。

approved_tools.en: UBC provides Copilot Chat (Basic) to eligible students, faculty, and staff via UBC credentials with enterprise data protection (prompts/responses not used to train foundation models). Launched October 15, 2026, M365 Copilot (Premium) is a paid annual Workday subscription for eligible faculty and staff only and is not available to students. Under CTLT PIA guidance for required course use (updated February 17, 2026), ChatGPT 5 (Without An Account) is assessed low risk for required course use with caution (though it does not protect personal information and shares data outside Canada), while ChatGPT 5 (With An Account) must not be required for a course. Tool access or PIA status never grants assessment permission. CTLT Low Risk input guidance is specifically about what instructors can require students to share in a course; it is not a blanket approval or restriction for every Premium use.
approved_tools.zh: UBC 通过校园凭据为符合资格的学生、教职人员提供具备企业级数据保护的 Copilot Chat（Basic）版本（用户的提示词与生成内容不被用于训练基础模型）。于 2026 年 10 月 15 日上线的 M365 Copilot（Premium）为仅面向符合资格教职工的 Workday 年度付费订阅服务，不对学生开放。依据 CTLT 针对课程强制工具使用的 PIA 指南（2026 年 2 月 17 日更新），ChatGPT 5（无账号版）在谨慎使用的前提下被评估为低风险（但该版本不保护个人信息且会将数据传输至加拿大境外），而 ChatGPT 5（有账号版）严禁在课程中强制要求使用。获得工具权限或 PIA 合规评定绝不代表获得在考核中使用的许可。CTLT 低风险输入指南专门规范教师可要求学生在课程中共享的内容，并非对所有 Premium 用途的一揽子批准或限制。

research_publication.en: In the Faculty of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies (Graduate School) at UBC Vancouver (grad.ubc.ca), substantive GenAI use in graduate research or thesis drafting requires prior supervisor/committee approval, and thesis/dissertation prefaces must name each tool used and explain its purpose or include a clear statement that GenAI was not deliberately used (UBCO College of Graduate Studies thesis preface specifications were not separately verified in reviewed sources). Across UBC, researchers and educators must respect Indigenous data sovereignty and obtain express community permission before entering Indigenous knowledges or data into AI tools.
research_publication.zh: 在 UBC 温哥华校区研究生与博士后学院（grad.ubc.ca），在研究生科研或论文起草中实质性使用生成式 AI 必须获得导师或指导委员会的事先批准，且学位论文或毕业论文前言必须指明每种工具及其用途，或包含明确声明未蓄意使用 GenAI（已审核来源中未单独验证奥肯那根校区研究生院论文前言要求）。在 UBC 全校范围内，研究人员与教师必须尊重原住民数据主权，在将原住民知识或数据输入 AI 工具前必须取得原住民社群的明确许可。

academic_integrity.en: All GenAI use must adhere to Academic Misconduct regulations in the Vancouver and Okanagan Academic Calendars; AI content detectors are strongly discouraged and Turnitin AI detection is disabled. Under Academic Calendar §11 (Appeals), the applicable Senate appeal rules depend on the date on which the alleged act of misconduct took place: for allegations of misconduct occurring on or after August 1, 2019 (§11.1–§11.2, §11.4–§11.5), a student must submit a written appeal to the Registrar within 45 calendar days from the date the student receives the President's letter, giving a full explanation of the grounds and containing all documents the student intends to rely upon (with Registrar extension discretion if appropriate), heard by at least 5 committee members at Vancouver and at least 4 at Okanagan (unless the student consents to fewer), with written and oral submissions, legal counsel representation, and a support person; for allegations occurring prior to August 1, 2019 (§11.1–§11.3), the Registrar must receive written notification within 45 calendar days of the date of the President's letter and the student may be represented or assisted by any person, including legal counsel. For Vancouver, any appeal involving allegations before 1 August 2019 uses the historical rules; the revised rules apply only to appeals involving solely allegations on or after 1 August 2019. The reviewed Okanagan page has separate before/after headings but does not independently establish mixed-date case handling.
academic_integrity.zh: 所有生成式 AI 的使用必须严格遵守温哥华与奥肯那根《大学历书》中的学术不端规章；校方强烈反对使用 AI 内容检测器，且已停用 Turnitin AI 检测功能。依据《大学历书》第 11 节（申诉程序），适用的参议院申诉规则取决于涉嫌不端行为发生的具体日期：对于发生在 2019 年 8 月 1 日及之后的涉嫌不端行为（§11.1–§11.2, §11.4–§11.5），学生必须在收到校长来信之日起 45 个日历日内向教务长提交书面申诉，详述申诉理由并提交全部拟依据的文件（教务长在适当时拥有延期自由裁量权），温哥华由至少 5 名委员会成员听证，奥肯那根由至少 4 名听证（除非学生同意减少人数），允许书面与口头陈述、法律顾问代理及支持人员陪同；对于发生在 2019 年 8 月 1 日之前的涉嫌不端行为（§11.1–§11.3），教务长须在校长来信之日起 45 个日历日内收到书面通知，学生可由任何人士（包括法律顾问）代理或协助。对于温哥华校区，任何涉及 2019 年 8 月 1 日前指控的申诉均适用历史规则；修订后规则仅适用于完全涉及 2019 年 8 月 1 日及之后指控的申诉。已审核的奥肯那根页面包含前后分列标题，但未单独明确混合日期案例的审理规则。

governance.en: Under BC FIPPA, UBC requires case-by-case Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) for university tools and initiatives handling personal information, and requires a dedicated PIA before any AI tool is used to enter student/learning data for feedback or grading. A single centralized public AI procurement registry was not identified in the specific reviewed UBC sources.
governance.zh: 根据不列颠哥伦比亚省《信息自由与隐私保护法》（BC FIPPA），UBC 要求对涉及个人信息处理的大学工具与项目执行逐案隐私影响评估（PIA），并要求在将任何 AI 工具用于输入学生学习数据以提供反馈或评分前，必须获得专门针对该用途的 PIA 批准。在已审核的 UBC 公开来源中，未发现全校统一的公开 AI 采购注册清单。

teaching.en: Faculty and staff may use GenAI in teaching and learning within legal, university, Faculty, and program-level boundaries. Effective September 1, 2026, Senate Policies V-130 (Vancouver) and O-130.1 (Okanagan) require syllabi for all credit-bearing courses (graduate-level theses and dissertation courses exempt) to include Academic Integrity and GenAI usage statements, provided within the first week of class unless created in consultation with the student(s) at the beginning of a course section (finalized prior to the drop-without-"W" deadline). Instructors must not upload student work or third-party copyright material to unapproved AI tools.
teaching.zh: 教职人员可在法律、大学规章、院系及项目要求框架内将生成式 AI 运用于教学。自 2026 年 9 月 1 日起，温哥华校区参议院政策 V-130 与奥肯那根校区参议院政策 O-130.1 要求所有学分课程（研究生学位论文与毕业论文课程豁免）的教学大纲必须包含学术诚信与生成式 AI 使用说明条款，须在开学第一周内向学生提供（除非在开课之初与学生协商制定大纲，此时须在退课免记 W 截止日前确定）。教师严禁将学生作业或第三方受版权保护资料上传至未经批准的 AI 工具。

teaching_guidance.en: Faculty and staff may use GenAI in teaching and learning within legal, university, Faculty, and program-level boundaries. Effective September 1, 2026, Vancouver Senate Policy V-130 and Okanagan Senate Policy O-130.1 require syllabi for all credit-bearing courses (graduate-level theses and dissertation courses exempt) to include an explicit statement on generative AI usage clarifying permitted and prohibited uses, as well as an academic integrity statement. Syllabi must be provided within the first week of class unless created in consultation with students at the start of the course section, in which case the syllabus must be finalized prior to the deadline to drop the course without receiving a 'W' on the transcript.
teaching_guidance.zh: 教职员工可在遵守法律、大学、学部及项目层面规范的前提下，在教学活动中使用生成式 AI。自2026年9月1日起，温哥华校区评议会 V-130 政策与奥肯那根校区评议会 O-130.1 政策要求所有学分课程（研究生学位论文课程除外）的大纲中必须包含明确的生成式 AI 使用说明（阐明允许与禁止的情形）及学术诚信声明。教学大纲须于开课首周内提供，若大纲系开课之初与学生共同协商制定，则必须在退课不记成绩单'W'标记的截止日前最终确定。

security_procurement.en: Under BC FIPPA, instructors and teaching assistants cannot require students to use generative AI or any other technology tool that involves sharing personal information unless the tool has undergone a completed UBC Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) approved for that use. Users must not enter personal information into any generative AI tool that has not completed UBC's FIPPA compliance assessment, as doing so may breach privacy. Specifically for instructional purposes, student and learning data—including identifiable grades and exam materials—should not be entered into any AI tool for feedback or grading unless the tool has an approved PIA for that specific purpose. A university-wide central AI procurement registry covering all institutional initiatives remains unverified in reviewed public records.
security_procurement.zh: 根据卑诗省《信息自由与隐私保护法》（BC FIPPA），教师及助教不得强制要求学生使用涉及共享个人信息的生成式 AI 或其他技术工具，除非该工具已通过 UBC 隐私影响评估（PIA）并获准用于该用途。师生不得将个人信息输入任何未经 UBC FIPPA 合规评估的生成式 AI 工具中，否则可能构成隐私侵权。在教学场景中，学生及学习数据（包括可识别的成绩与考试材料）原则上不得（should not）输入任何未就该特定目的完成 PIA 评估的 AI 工具用于评估反馈或判分。全校统一的集中式 AI 采购登记库在已审核公开记录中仍未核实。

do.en: Get express permission from your instructor, supervisor, or program before using GenAI in assessed work, and check the course syllabus statement (Senate V-130 / O-130.1).
do.zh: 在评分考核作品中使用生成式 AI 前必须获得授课教师、导师或项目明确许可，并查阅课程大纲中的 GenAI 说明条款（参议院 V-130 / O-130.1）。

do.en: Follow course acknowledgement rules when AI is permitted, and in UBC Vancouver Graduate School theses declare each AI tool and purpose in the Preface (or state non-use).
do.zh: 在获准使用 AI 的课程中遵守标注规范；在 UBC 温哥华校区研究生院学位论文前言中列明每种工具与用途（或明确声明未使用）。

do.en: Check purpose-specific UBC privacy approval; in instructor-required course use of Copilot for Organizations, required student inputs are limited to U1 Low Risk information.
do.zh: 核实符合具体用途的 UBC 隐私审批；教师强制课程使用 Copilot for Organizations 时，可要求学生输入的内容限于 U1 低风险信息。

dont.en: Do not enter personal, confidential, or student grading data into uncleared AI tools, and do not require students to sign up for ChatGPT 5 with an account in a course.
dont.zh: 切勿将个人信息、机密资料或学生成绩输入未经 PIA 审批的 AI 工具，且不得在课程中强制要求学生注册使用 ChatGPT 5 有账号版本。

dont.en: Do not treat institutional access to Copilot Chat (Basic) or CTLT low-risk PIA status for ChatGPT 5 (Without An Account) as permission to use AI on assessed work.
dont.zh: 切勿将机构的 Copilot Chat（Basic）访问权限或 CTLT 对 ChatGPT 5（无账号版）的低风险 PIA 状态视作可在考核作业中使用 AI 的许可。

dont.en: Do not use generative AI in examinations or assignments without express permission; unauthorized use is subject to Academic Calendar misconduct and §11 appeal rules.

topicBasis.coursework: Students may only use generative AI for coursework and assignments if expressly permitted by their instructor or program. Effective September 1, 2026, Vancouver Senate Policy V-130 and Okanagan Senate Policy O-130.1 require syllabi for all credit-bearing courses (graduate-level theses and dissertation courses are exempt) to include a GenAI usage statement, provided within the first week of class unless the syllabus is created in consultation with the student(s) at the beginning of a course section (in which case it must be finalized prior to the last date to drop the course without receiving a 'W' on the transcript).
topicBasis.exams: Students must not use generative AI in examinations or other assessed work unless expressly permitted by their course instructor or program. University-wide uniform exam exemption rules were not identified in the specific reviewed UBC sources; assessment-level boundaries are set by instructors and unauthorized use is addressed as academic misconduct under the Vancouver and Okanagan Academic Calendars.
topicBasis.disclosure: Where GenAI is permitted in assessed coursework, educators specify when and how students must acknowledge its use. In the Faculty of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies (Graduate School) at UBC Vancouver (grad.ubc.ca), graduate students must obtain supervisor/committee approval for substantive GenAI use and must declare in the thesis or dissertation Preface each AI tool used and its purpose, or include a clear statement that generative AI was not deliberately used for any aspect of the work (UBCO College of Graduate Studies thesis preface specifications were not separately verified in reviewed sources).
topicBasis.privacy_data: Do not enter personal information into unapproved AI tools; student learning/grading data requires a PIA approved for that purpose. CTLT guidance concerns instructor-required course tool use, not voluntary student choice: it says instructors cannot require ChatGPT 5 with an account, and limits what students can be instructed to share with Copilot for Organizations to Standard U1 Low Risk information. Other Copilot use follows current authorized-purpose, privacy, security and records requirements.
topicBasis.approved_tools: UBC provides Copilot Chat (Basic) to eligible students, faculty, and staff via UBC credentials with enterprise data protection (prompts/responses not used to train foundation models). Launched October 15, 2026, M365 Copilot (Premium) is a paid annual Workday subscription for eligible faculty and staff only and is not available to students. Under CTLT PIA guidance for required course use (updated February 17, 2026), ChatGPT 5 (Without An Account) is assessed low risk for required course use with caution (though it does not protect personal information and shares data outside Canada), while ChatGPT 5 (With An Account) must not be required for a course. Tool access or PIA status never grants assessment permission. CTLT Low Risk input guidance is specifically about what instructors can require students to share in a course; it is not a blanket approval or restriction for every Premium use.
topicBasis.research_publication: In the Faculty of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies (Graduate School) at UBC Vancouver (grad.ubc.ca), substantive GenAI use in graduate research or thesis drafting requires prior supervisor/committee approval, and thesis/dissertation prefaces must name each tool used and explain its purpose or include a clear statement that GenAI was not deliberately used (UBCO College of Graduate Studies thesis preface specifications were not separately verified in reviewed sources). Across UBC, researchers and educators must respect Indigenous data sovereignty and obtain express community permission before entering Indigenous knowledges or data into AI tools.
topicBasis.academic_integrity: All GenAI use must adhere to Academic Misconduct regulations in the Vancouver and Okanagan Academic Calendars; AI content detectors are strongly discouraged and Turnitin AI detection is disabled. Effective September 1, 2026, Vancouver Senate Policy V-130 and Okanagan Senate Policy O-130.1 require syllabi for all credit-bearing courses (graduate-level theses and dissertation courses are exempt) to include a GenAI usage statement, provided within the first week of class unless the syllabus is created in consultation with the student(s) at the beginning of a course section (in which case it must be finalized prior to the last date to drop the course without receiving a "W" on the transcript).
coursework.zh: 学生仅在授课教师或所属学术项目明确许可的情况下，方可在课程作业与平时评估中使用生成式 AI。自 2026 年 9 月 1 日起，温哥华校区参议院政策 V-130 与奥肯那根校区参议院政策 O-130.1 要求所有学分课程（研究生学位论文与毕业论文课程豁免）的教学大纲必须包含生成式 AI 使用说明条款，须在开学第一周内向学生提供，除非该大纲是在开课之初与学生协商制定的（在此情况下，须在不记录成绩单 W 的退课截止日期前最终确定）。

exams.zh: 除非授课教师或所属学术项目明确许可，学生严禁在考试或其他正式考核中使用生成式 AI。在已审核的具体 UBC 证据中，未发现全校统一的考试豁免规则；具体的考核使用界限由教师设定，未经授权的使用行为将依据温哥华与奥肯那根《大学历书》按学术不端予以处理。
exams.meaningEn: Examinations and formal assessments across UBC Vancouver and UBC Okanagan
exams.meaningZh: UBC 温哥华与奥肯那根校区的各级考试与正式测验

privacy_data.en: Do not enter personal information into unapproved AI tools; student learning/grading data requires a PIA approved for that purpose. Other Copilot use follows current authorized-purpose, privacy, security and records requirements.
privacy_data.zh: 切勿将个人信息输入未经批准的 AI 工具；若将学生学习或评分数据输入 AI 工具，必须通过专门为此用途批准的隐私影响评估（PIA）。CTLT 指南主要针对教师强制要求的课程工具使用，而非学生自愿的个人选择：该指南明确教师不得要求学生注册使用 ChatGPT 5 账号版，并限制向学生布置使用企业版 Copilot（Copilot for Organizations）时仅可输入标准 U1 低风险信息。其他 Copilot 的使用必须遵循当前的授权用途、隐私、信息安全及记录管理规定。
privacy_data.meaningEn: Personal information, student records, and institutional data handling under BC FIPPA and UBC Information Security Standard U1
privacy_data.meaningZh: BC FIPPA 法案与 UBC 信息安全标准 U1 管辖下的个人信息、学生记录及机构数据处理

approved_tools.en: UBC provides Copilot Chat (Basic) to eligible students, faculty, and staff via UBC credentials with enterprise data protection (prompts/responses not used to train foundation models). Launched October 15, 2026, M365 Copilot (Premium) is a paid annual Workday subscription for eligible faculty and staff only and is not available to students. Under CTLT PIA guidance for required course use (updated February 17, 2026), ChatGPT 5 (Without An Account) is assessed low risk for required course use with caution (though it does not protect personal information and shares data outside Canada), while ChatGPT 5 (With An Account) must not be required for a course. Tool access or PIA status never grants assessment permission. CTLT Low Risk input guidance is specifically about what instructors can require students to share in a course; it is not a blanket approval or restriction for every Premium use.
approved_tools.zh: UBC 通过校园凭据为符合资格的学生、教职人员提供具备企业级数据保护的 Copilot Chat（Basic）版本（用户的提示词与生成内容不被用于训练基础模型）。于 2026 年 10 月 15 日上线的 M365 Copilot（Premium）为仅面向符合资格教职工的 Workday 年度付费订阅服务，不对学生开放。依据 CTLT 针对课程强制工具使用的 PIA 指南（2026 年 2 月 17 日更新），ChatGPT 5（无账号版）在谨慎使用的前提下被评估为低风险（但该版本不保护个人信息且会将数据传输至加拿大境外），而 ChatGPT 5（有账号版）严禁在课程中强制要求使用。获得工具权限或 PIA 合规评定绝不代表获得在考核中使用的许可。CTLT 低风险输入指南专门规范教师可要求学生在课程中共享的内容，并非对所有 Premium 用途的一揽子批准或限制。
approved_tools.meaningEn: Institutional Microsoft Copilot tiers (Basic for all eligible CWL users vs Premium for faculty/staff) and CTLT PIA evaluations for mandatory course-required tools
approved_tools.meaningZh: 机构 Microsoft Copilot 分级（面向全校 CWL 资格用户的 Basic 版与面向教职工的 Premium 版）以及 CTLT 对课程强制要求工具的 PIA 评估

academic_integrity.zh: 所有生成式 AI 的使用必须严格遵守温哥华与奥肯那根《大学历书》中的学术不端规章；校方强烈反对使用 AI 内容检测器，且已停用 Turnitin AI 检测功能。依据《大学历书》第 11 节（申诉程序），适用的参议院申诉规则取决于涉嫌不端行为发生的具体日期：对于发生在 2019 年 8 月 1 日及之后的涉嫌不端行为（§11.1–§11.2, §11.4–§11.5），学生必须在收到校长来信之日起 45 个日历日内向教务长提交书面申诉，详述申诉理由并提交全部拟依据的文件（教务长在适当时拥有延期自由裁量权），温哥华由至少 5 名委员会成员听证，奥肯那根由至少 4 名听证（除非学生同意减少人数），允许书面与口头陈述、法律顾问代理及支持人员陪同；对于发生在 2019 年 8 月 1 日之前的涉嫌不端行为（§11.1–§11.3），教务长须在校长来信之日起 45 个日历日内收到书面通知，学生可由任何人士（包括法律顾问）代理或协助。对于温哥华校区，任何涉及 2019 年 8 月 1 日前指控的申诉均适用历史规则；修订后规则仅适用于完全涉及 2019 年 8 月 1 日及之后指控的申诉。已审核的奥肯那根页面包含前后分列标题，但未单独明确混合日期案例的审理规则。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: Academic misconduct regulations, AI detector restrictions, student advocacy services, and Vancouver/Okanagan Senate disciplinary appeals (post-August 1, 2019 vs pre-August 1, 2019 alleged misconduct regimes)

teaching.zh: 教职人员可在法律、大学规章、院系及项目要求框架内将生成式 AI 运用于教学。自 2026 年 9 月 1 日起，温哥华校区参议院政策 V-130 与奥肯那根校区参议院政策 O-130.1 要求所有学分课程（研究生学位论文与毕业论文课程豁免）的教学大纲必须包含学术诚信与生成式 AI 使用说明条款，须在开学第一周内向学生提供（除非在开课之初与学生协商制定大纲，此时须在退课免记 W 截止日前确定）。教师严禁将学生作业或第三方受版权保护资料上传至未经批准的 AI 工具。

teaching_guidance.zh: 教职员工可在遵守法律、大学、学部及项目层面规范的前提下，在教学活动中使用生成式 AI。自2026年9月1日起，温哥华校区评议会 V-130 政策与奥肯那根校区评议会 O-130.1 政策要求所有学分课程（研究生学位论文课程除外）的大纲中必须包含明确的生成式 AI 使用说明（阐明允许与禁止的情形）及学术诚信声明。教学大纲须于开课首周内提供，若大纲系开课之初与学生共同协商制定，则必须在退课不记成绩单'W'标记的截止日前最终确定。

security_procurement.en: Under BC FIPPA, instructors and teaching assistants cannot require students to use generative AI or any other technology tool that involves sharing personal information unless the tool has undergone a completed UBC Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) approved for that use. Users must not enter personal information into any generative AI tool that has not completed UBC's FIPPA compliance assessment, as doing so may breach privacy. Specifically for instructional purposes, student and learning data—including identifiable grades and exam materials—should not be entered into any AI tool for feedback or grading unless the tool has an approved PIA for that specific purpose. A university-wide central AI procurement registry covering all institutional initiatives remains unverified in reviewed public records.
security_procurement.zh: 根据卑诗省《信息自由与隐私保护法》（BC FIPPA），教师及助教不得强制要求学生使用涉及共享个人信息的生成式 AI 或其他技术工具，除非该工具已通过 UBC 隐私影响评估（PIA）并获准用于该用途。师生不得将个人信息输入任何未经 UBC FIPPA 合规评估的生成式 AI 工具中，否则可能构成隐私侵权。在教学场景中，学生及学习数据（包括可识别的成绩与考试材料）原则上不得（should not）输入任何未就该特定目的完成 PIA 评估的 AI 工具用于评估反馈或判分。全校统一的集中式 AI 采购登记库在已审核公开记录中仍未核实。
security_procurement.meaningEn: Personal information protection under BC FIPPA, mandatory PIAs for required instructional tools, and purpose-specific grading data controls
security_procurement.meaningZh: 卑诗省 FIPPA 下的个人信息保护、强制性教学工具 PIA 审查以及教学判分数据特定控制
